data.narrative:
Greenroom Robotics is a Series A defense and security robotics company founded by Harry Hubbert, Zac Pullen, and James Keane. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Singularity, and NODA AI.

The peer-median method anchors the analysis. The 10-company cohort exhibits valuations ranging from $125M to $3.0B, with a median of $1.0B. Represented peers at Series B include Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), establishing a clear valuation floor for the sector at this stage.

The triangulated range supports a valuation of $850M to $1.1B, with a median of $1.0B. This reflects a single but highly relevant methodology applied to a substantive peer set. Key uncertainties include the stage discount appropriate for Series A relative to the Series B-dominant comparable set, and the extent to which Greenroom's specific technology, market traction, and founding team command a premium or discount within this range. Further methods (revenue multiple, DCF, or transaction multiples) would narrow confidence intervals but are not supported by available data.
